newsitem.title: UK: IPE natural gas seen drifting after slow Monday.
newsitem.headline: IPE natural gas seen drifting after slow Monday.

text.p: IPE natural gas prices were not expected to move sharply on Tuesday although the scarcity of trade on Monday made relative comparisons hard to make, traders and brokers said.
Business was very thin on the IPE on Monday and price movements were marginal. May, June and July all closed at around 10.3 pence per therm.
"There is nothing major that I know of that will have an impact today," one IPE broker said.
"It has had a bit of support at around 10.3 pence for the first few months and maybe that will hold again today."
Forward trade on the physical market was thin on Monday, too, although the short term market was more active.
